title: Ecological dark matter: Insect decline and the planetary monitoring gap
content:
by Justin Crocker

Wherever we look, insect numbers are declining, but most insect life on Earth is found in locations we are not actively monitoring. The defining task of the next decade will be to build the planetary observatory that biodiversity science requires. Wherever we look, insect numbers are declining, but most insect life on Earth is found in locations we are not actively monitoring. This Perspective discusses the insect decline and how can we build in the next decade the planetary observatory that biodiversity requires.
author: Justin Crocker
